item.text: The ResStock team recommends **at least 1,000 samples** as a general default when no analysis-specific information is available. Their FAQ describes this as a conservative reference for keeping sampling discrepancy at 15% or lower for many common quantities of interest. [ResStock FAQ](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/FAQ.html)
